title: Add PAYDAY 2 Web localhost smoke test
acceptance_criteria: `python3 .tmp/local-smoke-tests/payday2_web_smoke.py` exits 0 after starting PAYDAY 2 Web and verifying a bounded localhost readiness check.
The smoke test only calls localhost endpoints and avoids dependence on Steam or any other remote service.
The smoke test terminates any process it started before exit, including timeout and failure paths.
The test remains reproducible on a machine with only the repo checkout and Python stdlib available for the web surface.
